title: Installation of the Fwd Cargo Door Latch Pin Bushings and Pins

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the latch pin housing bushings and the eight latch pins of the forward cargo door, including the rigging check and the door operational test that close the task out.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to press the bushings into the latch pin housings of the forward cargo door, to install the eight latch pins and to do the rigging check of the latch mechanism.
sections.job_setup_note: The bores must be clean, dry and within the dimension given in the illustration before the bushings are pressed. Check every bore with the bore gauge and record the reading, because a bore that has been re-worked at a previous visit may be outside the standard press interference. The latch mechanism must stay locked at the unlocked stop until the rigging check. Two people are needed at the press stage and for the rigging check.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the latch mechanism locking pin is still installed. 2. Measure each housing bore with the bore gauge and record the reading. CAUTION: DO NOT PRESS A BUSHING INTO A BORE THAT IS OUTSIDE THE DIMENSION IN THE ILLUSTRATION. THE INTERFERENCE WILL BE LOST AND THE BUSHING WILL TURN IN SERVICE. 3. Put a light film of the approved compound on the outer face of the first bushing. 4. Set the arbor square to the bore and press the bushing home in one movement. 5. Do steps 3 and 4 again for the other seven bushings. 6. Install the splice plate D5230131366114 and torque the fasteners. 7. Install the eight latch pins and fit new retaining nuts and split pins. 8. Install the retention plate D5230135480243 at each end of the latch beam. 9. Re-clip the latch beam harness with the cable ties EN816709K3 to the routing in the illustration. 10. Remove the locking pin and drive the latch mechanism by hand through one full cycle. 11. Do the rigging check and adjust the hook overlap to the dimension given. WARNING: KEEP CLEAR OF THE LATCH HOOKS DURING THE OPERATIONAL TEST. 12. Energise the door actuation system and do the door operational test.
sections.close_out: Confirm that the latch position indicator 1490WV shows locked with the door closed and unlocked with the door open. Remove the maintenance stay and the warning notices. Do a leak check of the door seal at the next pressurisation. Record the bore readings, the hook overlap and the operational test result on the aircraft work card.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Post MOD-160915 aircraft use the dry-film bushing and the enlarged bore dimension; the compound in step 3 is not applied to dry-film items.

safety_precautions: Keep the latch mechanism locking pin installed until step 10.
Keep clear of the latch hooks during the operational test.
Put the warning notices in position at the door control panel.
